page.layout: One printed page, running text in a single column. Top: running text, full width, continued from the previous page. Below: the approbations (censurae), set in italic, one paragraph each. Then a decorative band, the title block (centred), the list of the subscribing theologians, and the body text with a large woodcut initial R. Margin: left, printed line numbers 5 to 60; right, the marginal note "Anno 1606" beside the title and a note beside the list.

main_text.l: Properans itaq; ad conclusionem; dico, Rempubl. tot & tam validas suæ partis rationes habere,
quæ ipsam in hoc negotio etiam ne minimum quidem errorem commisisse facile conuincere
possint; & peccasset sane; si quicquam factorum omisisset, siquidem in bona gubernatione sub-
ditorum defecisset, & suæ ipsius paci ac tranquillitati male consuluisset. Quapropter à Pontifice
legitime culpari sese haud putat bonitati causæ confidens; quia sane freta omnes Principes &
populos à suis partibus haud dubie habebit; [?]nec dubitat sane quin & ipse Pontifex proprio suo
consilio ab omni falsa falsariorum suasione alieno tandem cogniturus, reique bonæ iustas
causas & infallibiles rationes recepturus sit, cui Deus Opt. Max. benefaciat, vt ad beneficium commu-
ne nominis Christiani cedat; Amen.
CENSVRÆ PRÆSTANTIVM VIRORVM.

REQVIRIT sane, quod quisque in cultu diuino & cura propriæ salutis regi de-
bet, zelus in hoc præsertim tempore, quo controuersiæ quam maximæ inter
Pontificem & serenissimam Rempub. agitantur, vt has duas inprimis quæs-
tiones diligenter examinando decidamus.
An scilicet Ecclesiastici debeant aut possint interdictum huius status
sine peccato obseruare? Et an Princeps Venetus possit & debeat, vt ad defen-
sionem, talem obseruationem prohibere?
Ad probandum, quod Ecclesiastici huius status ad illius obseruationem sint obligati,
& quod Princeps etiam debeat in id consentire, putant aliqui se satis præstitisse, si demonstrauerint,
quod vnusquisq; obligatus sit ad iustis præceptis Papæ obediendi. Ad quod probandum, multum
& nostra quidem opinione extra rem ac superflue laborant: siquidem non hoc solummodo illis
concedimus, sed etiam quod Episcoporum iustis præceptis obedientiam omnino debeamus,

page.notes: Printed line numbers in the left margin (5 to 60) are transcribed as notes at their lines. The woodcut band between the censure and the title is ornament only and is not transcribed. The top-left edge of the scan shows show-through from the facing page and is omitted. Doubtful readings: "[?]nec" (the printed word may be "hoc" or "nec"), "Scaiinus" (possible spelling variant), the right-margin note "Auctor scripti est" (the word "scripti" is hard to read), and the catchword "vi" at the bottom right, which may be a catchword or a page signature. The signature "EE" is centred at the foot. The printed line numbers are placed at the paragraph where their line falls, which is approximate.
